newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Boulevard says to buy Alliance Technologies.
newsitem.headline: Boulevard says to buy Alliance Technologies.

text.p: Boulevard Properties Holdings Inc said on Thursday its board had approved a proposal to buy a majority stake in Alliance Technologies Corporation.

President Abelardo Villacorta said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange that the board had approved the proposed acquisition by Boulevard Properties of 28,620 shares for a total 6.832 million pesos.
"The block of sales acquired represent a majority stake in ATC (or) more than 50 percent," he said.

The unlisted Alliance Technologies deals in a wide-range of information technology products and services, including voice/fax mail system, voice response system, computer telephony integration and networking.
